gates.description: Gate A1 is located at the far north end of Terminal 1, near the international departures wing. It serves wide-body aircraft including Boeing 777 and Airbus A380 flights.
Gate A2 is adjacent to Gate A1 in Terminal 1, positioned right after the first set of escalators. It handles mid-range international routes.

Gate B12 is located in Terminal 2, on Level 2, accessible via the central elevator bank or escalators from the B-concourse entrance. Follow the blue 'B Gates' signs from the security checkpoint. It primarily serves domestic and regional flights.
Gate C5 is in the south wing of Terminal 3, accessible via the moving walkway from the main Terminal 3 security exit. It serves low-cost carrier domestic flights.

Gate D3 is at the end of the D-concourse in Terminal 3. It is the furthest gate from security — take the shuttle train from the main terminal or walk 15 minutes. Serves charter and cargo-mixed flights.

terminals.name: Terminal 1
terminals.description: Terminal 1 is the international departures terminal, handling all intercontinental and long-haul international flights. It features a world-class duty-free mall, premium lounges, and fine dining. The terminal spans four levels connected by escalators, elevators, and moving walkways.
terminals.access: Enter via the International Departures main entrance on Level 1. Dedicated drop-off zone on the ground floor. Sky Bridge connects to the hotel on Level 3.

terminals.name: Terminal 2
terminals.description: Terminal 2 handles domestic and short-haul international flights. It is modern and compact, designed for fast boarding. It features a food court, shopping, and quick-service lounges. Security is typically faster here than Terminal 1.
terminals.access: Enter via Terminal 2 Departure Hall on Level 1. Shared parking structure with Terminal 1. Shuttle bus connects Terminal 2 to Terminal 3 every 10 minutes.

terminals.name: Terminal 3
terminals.description: Terminal 3 is a dedicated low-cost carrier and regional terminal. It offers basic amenities with budget-friendly food and retail options. The terminal has two concourses, C and D, with D-concourse served by an automated shuttle train.
terminals.access: Accessible via the Airport Ring Road on Level 1. Terminal 3 has its own dedicated check-in counters (rows 40–60). Shuttle bus from Terminal 2 stops at the T3 main entrance.

food_courts.name: Café Aroma
food_courts.description: Café Aroma serves artisan coffees, fresh-baked pastries, sandwiches, and light bites. Perfect for a quick snack before a long international flight. Offers specialty blends from three continents.

food_courts.name: The Runway Grill
food_courts.description: The Runway Grill is the main sit-down restaurant in Terminal 2. It offers a full menu spanning Indian curries and thalis, continental mains, pasta, and a dedicated Chinese corner. Great choice for families.

food_courts.name: QuickBite Fast Food
food_courts.description: QuickBite is a 24-hour fast food outlet offering burgers, wraps, fries, cold beverages, and meal combos. Ideal for budget travellers seeking a fast and filling option.

food_courts.name: Spice Garden
food_courts.description: Spice Garden specialises in authentic South Indian breakfast items (idli, dosa, vada) as well as North Indian tandoori dishes and biryanis for lunch and dinner.

shops.name: SkyMall Duty-Free
current_offers: Buy 2 get 1 free on selected perfumes (Chanel, Dior)
15% off on all single malt Scotch whiskies above ₹5000
Complimentary luxury gift wrapping on purchases above ₹3000
shops.description: SkyMall is the flagship duty-free store in Terminal 1. It is the largest retail space in the airport, spanning 4,000 sq ft, stocking global luxury and lifestyle brands. Open to all international departing passengers.

shops.name: World Spirits & Wines
current_offers: Buy any 2 bottles and get a premium whisky glass set free
10% extra discount when you spend over ₹8000
Special pricing on Moët & Chandon Champagne this week
shops.description: World Spirits & Wines is a specialist liquor boutique offering curated collections of premium spirits from Scotland, France, Ireland, and more. Expert staff offer tasting recommendations.

shops.name: IndiaMart Convenience Store
current_offers: 20% off on all power banks this week
shops.description: IndiaMart is the go-to convenience store in Terminal 2, stocking everything a traveller might need at the last minute — from medicines and snacks to phone chargers and neck pillows.

services.name: SkyLounge Premium Lounge
services.description: SkyLounge offers premium travellers a quiet, comfortable environment with unlimited food and beverages, high-speed Wi-Fi, private shower suites, massage chairs, and a business centre. Accessible with eligible credit cards, airline status, or day-pass purchase.
services.access: Credit card (Priority Pass, Amex Platinum, HDFC Infinia), Airline Business/First Class boarding pass, or Day Pass (₹2500)

services.name: Sky Connect Lounge
services.location: Terminal 2, Level 2, near central security exit
services.description: A mid-tier lounge in Terminal 2 offering hot and cold buffet, complimentary soft drinks and juices, Wi-Fi, and comfortable seating. Suitable for domestic travellers seeking respite before departure.
services.access: Select credit cards, Lounge Key membership, or Day Pass (₹1200)

services.name: Airport Medical Center
services.location: Terminal 1, Level 1, Arrival Hall, near Exit Gate 3
services.description: The Airport Medical Centre provides 24-hour emergency first aid, general consultations, vaccination certificates, blood pressure checks, and basic medicines. A licensed doctor and nurse are on duty at all times.
services.access: Open to all airport visitors. No appointment needed for emergencies.

services.name: ForexNow Currency Exchange
services.location: Terminal 1, Level 1, near Customs Exit; Terminal 2, Level 1, Check-in Hall
services.description: ForexNow offers competitive exchange rates for over 30 currencies. Services include currency exchange, travel cards (multi-currency prepaid), and international money transfers. Zero commission on orders above USD 500 equivalent.
services.access: Open to all travellers. Bring valid passport and boarding pass.

services.name: Restrooms — Terminal 2 Level 1
services.location: Terminal 2, Level 1, near Check-in counters B20–B30
services.description: Fully accessible restrooms with separate male, female, and gender-neutral facilities. Includes baby changing stations, accessible stalls for wheelchair users, and a lactation room.
services.access: Free, open to all airport users.

services.name: Restrooms — Terminal 1 Level 2
services.location: Terminal 1, Level 2, midway between Gate A1 and Gate A2
services.description: Premium restrooms featuring automatic flushing, electronic hand dryers, and vanity stations. Accessible restroom available. Separate prayer room adjacent.
services.access: Free, open to all airside passengers.

facilities.name: Kids Play Area
facilities.description: A safe, supervised play zone for children aged 2–12. Features soft-play structures, toy stations, and interactive digital games. Monitored by airport staff.

facilities.name: Baby Care Room
facilities.location: Terminal 1, Level 2, near Gate A1; Terminal 2, Level 1, near Check-in Hall
facilities.description: Private nursing and feeding room with comfortable seating, a changing table, warm water access, and a microwave. Free to use, no booking required.

facilities.name: Business Centre
facilities.description: Fully equipped business centre with private meeting pods, printing, scanning, video-conferencing facilities, and high-speed fibre internet. Available to lounge members and day-pass holders.

facilities.name: Charging Stations
facilities.location: Available at all gates in Terminal 1 and Terminal 2; Terminal 3 near C-concourse entrance
facilities.description: Free multi-standard charging stations (USB-A, USB-C, Type-B, wireless Qi charging pads) located throughout all terminals. Just plug in your device.

check_in_counters.name: International Check-in Zone A
check_in_counters.description: All international airline check-in counters are located in Terminal 1, Hall A. Self-check-in kiosks are available at the entrance. Web check-in is recommended; counters open 4 hours before departure.

check_in_counters.name: Domestic Check-in Zone B
check_in_counters.description: Domestic airline check-in counters in Terminal 2. Bag drop counters are available for passengers who have completed web check-in. Counters open 2.5 hours before departure.

check_in_counters.name: Budget Carrier Check-in Zone C
check_in_counters.description: Low-cost carrier check-in counters in Terminal 3. Strict baggage weight limits apply. Self-service kiosks are available near the entrance.
check_in_counters.hours: Open 3 hours before first flight of the day until final departure

baggage_belts.location: Terminal 1, Arrivals Hall, Level 0, south end
baggage_belts.description: International arrivals baggage belt for Air India and Emirates long-haul flights. Oversized baggage collection point is adjacent to Belt 1.

baggage_belts.location: Terminal 1, Arrivals Hall, Level 0, north end
baggage_belts.description: International arrivals belt for British Airways, Lufthansa, and Qatar Airways. Priority baggage is marked and arrives first.
Domestic arrivals baggage belt serving IndiGo, SpiceJet, and Vistara flights. Digital display above belt shows assigned flight numbers in real time.
